title: NativQA: Multilingual Culturally-Aligned Natural Query for LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM performance on MultiNativQA, a newly constructed region-specific and culturally-aligned natural question-answering dataset, to measure how well models handle non-Western cultural norms and regional knowledge using zero-shot prompting evaluated via BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, LLM-as-a-judge, and human evaluation.

Comparing QA performance disparities across seven languages spanning different resource tiers (from high-resource languages like English to extremely low-resource languages like Assamese and Nepali) to observe correlations between model accuracy and language representation.
